runtime.execution: DeepAgents SDK assembles LangChain/LangGraph compiled graph and middleware; provider transport/tool-node scheduling external; optional LangGraph-hosted async colleagues
runtime.service_boundary: Default state files, owned optional LocalShell; caller-supplied StoreBackend/checkpointer/sandbox and remote colleagues consumed. Talon/Code/ACP are separate repository products.

summary: Programmable graph/middleware agent SDK with backend files/execute, local/forked and remote asynchronous subagents, event-based compaction and recovery paths.

inspection.scope: Primary SDK graph, model request wrappers, native actions/backend dispatch, local/fork/hosted child lifecycle, store/memory, automatic/manual compaction, large-result capture, interruption patch and tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Unvendored LangChain/LangGraph/provider SDK loop and scheduler not implementation-audited; separate Code/ACP/Talon products and examples not comprehensively traced. Claims scoped to primary SDK. No reference executed.

actions.name: ls | read_file | glob | grep
actions.input: absolute paths; offset/limit; glob/literal pattern/path and search output options

actions.name: execute
actions.output: content plus exit_code/truncated artifact, possible capture file pointer
actions.lifecycle: awaited backend operation; no native persistent process handle

actions.name: task
actions.output: last AI text and selected state updates
actions.lifecycle: await child; isolated or effective-history fork; recursion guard

actions.name: start_async_task
actions.output: stable task/thread ID, run ID in state
actions.lifecycle: remote independent run; host caller consumes service

actions.name: check_async_task | list_async_tasks
actions.output: live status and successful thread result, tracked list
actions.authority: configured hosted client; only tracked tasks

actions.name: update_async_task
actions.lifecycle: interrupt existing remote run and start follow-up on same thread
actions.authority: model steering of configured hosted colleague

actions.name: cancel_async_task
actions.output: local cancelled state after remote cancel API
actions.lifecycle: request acceptance not independently verified quiescence
actions.authority: model can request remote task stop

actions.name: compact_conversation
actions.lifecycle: explicit summarization middleware must be configured; main graph uses automatic compactor
actions.authority: model-initiated if caller adds tool middleware

actions.name: create_deep_agent / custom AgentMiddleware / CompiledSubAgent
actions.output: compiled graph invoking external LangChain loop
actions.lifecycle: construction-time composition; mutable request hooks possible

actions.name: StoreBackend / LocalShellBackend
actions.lifecycle: cross-thread consumed store versus own local child process

actions.name: read_file conversation_history paths
actions.output: rendered earlier history if backend offload succeeded
actions.lifecycle: ordinary file read, not automatic restoration of original context

filesystem.detail: Backend-routed native list/read/write/edit/delete/glob/grep with permissions and standard results.

processes.detail: Conditional execute uses backend; LocalShell one subprocess per action, clipped output and lost timeout partials; no stable job lifecycle.

code_actions.detail: Command execution plus native file tools; exact authority and execution supplied backend.

persistent_kernel.detail: No resident interpreter in primary SDK/LocalShell paths; external backend may supply services but not traced.

standing_database.detail: StoreBackend consumes supplied BaseStore with runtime namespaces persistent across threads; native file abstraction, not model SQL/query API.

workflow_programming.detail: Program authors compose graph/middleware/runnables, custom tool and per-child specs; loop delegated to LangChain/LangGraph.

multi_model.detail: Each declarative subagent may specify distinct model/profile and inherits defaults otherwise.

live_collaboration.detail: Hosted async tasks allow model check/update/cancel while running; parent-to-child interrupting follow-up, no peer-to-peer IRC bus traced. Local task awaited.

concurrent_work.detail: Hosted runs execute independently with stable thread/task and run identity; local graph concurrency depends on unvendored tool scheduler.

steering_interrupt.detail: Remote update interrupt strategy and cancel API implemented; local cancelled status is not observed termination. Host HITL optional.

turn_redefinition.detail: Middleware can alter request/response and graph built from supplied programs; model editing does not hot-install new turn graph.

compaction.detail: Automatic summary events select effective history while retaining message channel; argument truncation, overflow recovery and optional model compact tool.

context_repair.detail: Model can reopen rendered offloaded conversation path; unmatched tool calls repaired. Offload nonfatal failures/media placeholders and pre-state tool eviction bound original recoverability.

original_audit.detail: Message channel preservation through summary is real but not raw provider audit; pre-state result eviction, backend clipping, rendered history, optional checkpoints/callbacks.

audit_query.detail: Native read_file enables offloaded rendered-history retrieval; checkpoint/store query semantics depend on host.

hot_change.detail: Graph/middleware composition construction-time; memory caches initial loaded files. No default whole-turn/workflow activation transaction.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Supplied checkpointer/store and external thread IDs can reconstitute graph data, but no quiescent executable handoff with owned process/provider custody.

remote_services.detail: Configurable model clients and hosted async deployments plus supplied storage/sandbox backends consumed.

self_improvement.detail: Model can edit memory/program files, framework can compose evaluation hooks, but no governed harness autoresearch loop in primary paths.

complaints.detail: No model state-capturing complaint operation in inspected SDK native action set.

authority.detail: Filesystem permissions and optional HITL merge; local shell explicitly full host authority, supplied backend decides isolation.

evaluation.detail: Strong mocked compaction budgets/reduced-retry/request-immutability and remote ID/strategy tests; no live remote custody verified.

time_order.detail: Summary cutoff/message identities, graph checkpoint channels and remote run IDs structure history; remote cancel and backend audit timing not total-order custody.

evidence.claim: create_deep_agent configurable model/tools/middleware/subagents/backend/checkpointer/store returns graph.
Default StateBackend and per-child model/permission/default middleware resolution.
Main filesystem/task/summarization/patch middleware and optional hosted async subagents, memory and HITL.
LangChain create_agent delegated loop/provider dispatch, supplied stores/checkpointer and graph state; dependencies not vendored.
Native file/search schema inputs including offsets, unique edits, deletion, literal grep.
Built-in file and execute tool factories.
Write path validation/permissions and backend delegation with ToolMessage.
Edit backend API and replace_all; results/errors paired to call ID.
Execute capability check/timeouts, optional offloaded capture or backend execute; artifact exit status with message success even nonzero command.
LocalShell fresh subprocess, explicit cwd/env, timeout, stdout/stderr combine then clip; timeout discards partial output.
Persistent StoreBackend consumes supplied or execution-context BaseStore, caller namespaces across threads.
Task isolated/fork contexts, awaited runnable invocation, recursion refusal and standardized return.
Child final nonempty AI text projected to parent plus state updates, not complete child transcript.
Hosted start creates thread/run and task record only after successful calls; partial-start cleanup not present.
Check remote run, success thread values and paired status update.
Update same task/thread, new run with multitask_strategy interrupt; stable task ID.
Cancel remote request then local cancelled status; remote termination not acknowledged by observation.
List tracked tasks including refreshed nonterminal status and filtering.
Effective history/argument truncation/summary event updates without destructive summary rewrite; one reduced overflow retry.
Offload rendered history to backend, warn/fail None nonfatal; not original wire audit.
Optional compact_conversation tool emits summary event, not automatically added in main graph.
Large tool content is processed/offloaded before addition to state; raw-state preservation has this boundary.
Memory files read once when memory_contents absent, cached in state.
Adds paired error results for unmatched/invalid calls and rewrites message list; cancellation factual status uncertain.
Mocked input budget, offloaded full result bytes and original request unchanged oracle.
Overflow retries smaller once; no-cutoff unchanged retry prohibited.
Mock remote update asserts same task ID/new run/interruption strategy; no actual remote concurrency/custody.
Name-based custom middleware replacement at graph construction, not runtime hot replacement.

tests.oracle: Handler enforces budget, full bytes offloaded, original request unchanged, retry strictly smaller and bounded; mock counter/backend do not prove full vendor fidelity.

tests.focus: Stable colleague identity and update strategy
tests.oracle: Mock asserts same thread/task, new run, multitask_strategy interrupt; remote resource termination/races remain external.

strengths: Compaction as an event/projection rather than destructive rewriting of every original message.
Consumed persistent store and hosted work boundaries fit Arconaut consumer intent better than agent-owned shared services.
Model-accessible hosted work has explicit IDs and follow-up/cancel operations.
limits: Unvendored LangChain/LangGraph/provider SDK loop and scheduler not implementation-audited; separate Code/ACP/Talon products and examples not comprehensively traced. Claims scoped to primary SDK. No reference executed.
arconaut_questions: Can capture be independent of model projection, backend clipping and nonfatal offload failures?
Can restart preserve caller task IDs while proving own activity quiescent and leaving shared deployments running?
How should a model install altered workflows at the end of affected workflow rather than only constructing a new graph?
